value.rationale: The canonical full inflection-tangent extension of the Fermat cubic is a distinguished non-nearly-free degree-twelve curve in the source literature. Its fixed integral model acquires precisely the dual-Hesse incidence lattice only in characteristic two, while the cubic stays smooth and all nine triple contacts persist. The all-prime rational singular spectrum is an exact natural arithmetic invariant of that meaningful degeneration, not an arbitrary enumerated slice.
